summary.zh: 同一 Wi-Fi 下让 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 和安卓 DSH Go 互换聊天记录、DSH-Shared 文件与已启用插件，断线后重连自动补传；DSH Go 输入框上方可直接看到同步状态
summary.en: Sync chats, DSH-Shared files and enabled plugins between Windows DeepSeek Harness and Android DSH Go over the same Wi-Fi, catching up after reconnects; the sync status sits above the DSH Go composer
